definitions.explanation: Small, round dumplings made from rice flour, often served on skewers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{団子|だんご}。
examples.english: Dumplings over flowers. (Proverb: Practical things over aesthetic pleasures)
examples.notes: Famous proverb meaning practicality over beauty

examples.japanese: ⟦みたらし→みたらし：noentry⟧{団子|だんご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三本|さんぼん}→〜本：00688_hon⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought three mitarashi dango skewers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{月見|つきみ}→月見：13001_tsukimi⟧{団子|だんご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供|そな}える→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧。
examples.notes: Tradition during the autumn moon festival

examples.japanese: ⟦{串|くし}→串：19339_kushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刺|さ}した→刺す：02111_sasu⟧⟦{三色|さんしょく}→三色：noentry⟧{団子|だんご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{見|み}かける→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧。
examples.english: Tri-colored dango on skewers are commonly seen during cherry blossom viewing season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白玉粉|しらたまこ}→白玉粉：24188_shiratamako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こねて→捏ねる：06187_koneru⟧⟦{丸|まる}めて→丸める：11313_marumeru⟧⟦ゆでれば→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧、⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{団子|だんご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}れる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}に→一緒に：25645_isshoni⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: If you knead shiratamako flour, roll it into balls, and boil them, you can easily make dango, so it's fun to make them together with children.

notes:
A traditional Japanese sweet made from rice flour (⟦{上新粉|じょうしんこ}→上新粉：28740_joushinko⟧/⟦{白玉粉|しらたまこ}→白玉粉：24188_shiratamako⟧). Common types:
- ⟦みたらし→みたらし：noentry⟧{団子|だんご} (with sweet soy glaze)
- ⟦{三色|さんしょく}→三色：noentry⟧{団子|だんご}/⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧{団子|だんご} (tri-color: pink, white, green)
- ⟦{月見|つきみ}→月見：13001_tsukimi⟧{団子|だんご} (plain white, for moon viewing)
- ⟦あんこ→餡子：08654_anko⟧{団子|だんご} (with sweet bean paste)
- ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧{団子|だんご} (with mugwort)
- ⟦ごま→胡麻：10337_goma⟧{団子|だんご} (with sesame)

Typically served on skewers (⟦{串|くし}→串：19339_kushi⟧). The proverb 「⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{団子|だんご}」 reflects the Japanese appreciation for practicality.

Counted: ⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧ (per skewer) or ⟦{一個|いっこ}→一個：08922_ikko⟧ (individual dumpling).
